title: VisionFaceCastMatchRequest
description: vision.face-cast-match-request@1: POST /api/v1/faces/cast/match, called by OpenVibe.Live with a service token scoped to one channel (vision.face.cast.match). It matches only that channel's opted-in adult roster; a person who has not enrolled for this channel cannot appear, and the answer does not say whether they exist.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
